title: TRICARE Prime: One Enrollment per Beneficiary and Changes Between Plans
content:
A beneficiary may hold at most **one TRICARE Prime enrollment** at a time (a limit of 1 per beneficiary).

## Clauses

1. An application for a beneficiary who already has an applied or active Prime enrollment is not a second enrollment.
2. A change of Prime option inside the region - for example from TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Family Member to TRICARE Prime Active Duty Family Member after a move into a Prime Service Area - ends the old enrollment and starts the new one on the qualifying-life-event date.
3. A beneficiary may not be enrolled in TRICARE Prime and TRICARE Select, or in TRICARE Prime and a premium-based plan (TRICARE Premium-Based Plans), at the same time. Holding an active TRICARE Select or premium-based plan enrollment means the Prime election is a plan change that ends the other enrollment on the day before the Prime effective date.

## Condition for a new enrollment

The beneficiary has no applied or active Prime enrollment in the region on the application date.

- **Whose record decides:** the region's own enrollment records for that beneficiary, as they stand before the enrollment is recorded; a caller's statement that no enrollment exists does not replace them.
- **Which records count:** only Prime enrollments of the same beneficiary whose status is applied or active. Enrollments that were rejected, disenrolled, terminated or transferred out do not stand in the way.

## Situations and outcomes

| What the records show for the beneficiary on the application date | Outcome under these clauses |
|---|---|
| No Prime enrollment, or only ended or rejected ones | the condition for a new enrollment is met |
| A Prime enrollment in applied status | the application is not a second enrollment |
| An active Prime enrollment | the application is not a second enrollment |
| An active TRICARE Select enrollment and a Prime election | the Prime election is a plan change; the Select enrollment ends on the day before the Prime effective date |

## Worked dates (hypothetical)

A beneficiary holding an active TRICARE Select enrollment elects TRICARE Prime with an effective date of 1 January. The Select enrollment ends on 31 December, the day before, so the two plans never overlap.
